name: Deutsche Beteiligungs AG
summary: Deutsche Beteiligungs AG is a private equity and venture capital firm based in Frankfurt am Main, Germany. Founded in 1965, it specializes in direct and fund-of-fund investments, including expansion capital, buyouts, growth financing, and corporate spin-offs. The firm targets small and medium-sized enterprises across sectors such as industrials, technology, healthcare, and infrastructure. The firm prefers to invest in companies with enterprise values between EUR 50 million ($57.62 million) and EUR 400 million($460.94 million). Deutsche Beteiligungs AG operates primarily in Germany, Austria, Switzerland, and other parts of Europe, with additional offices in Milan and Luxembourg.
